extraction.notes: The provider is developing its 2027 program list. It gives tentative overall weeks of June 13–18 and June 20–25, 2027, but does not assign programs to those weeks; cards retain explicitly labeled 2026 dates and prices. Registration is expected in mid-December 2026. Registration-platform links could not be recovered from the readable pages. The homepage says 2026 registration is closed; older program-page full/waitlist notices are not treated as 2027 availability. The FAQ's between-week checkout dates appear stale and were not used.
